title: refactor(rest): move registerSharingEndpoints and registerSharingRuleEndpoints into sharing-routes.ts (#23050 slice 4)
body:
Part of #23050
Clause-②: no

Slice 4 of the `rest-server.ts` split, by slice 1's pattern (landed note `6136102437`, steps 1–6), slice 2's getter refinement (`6189011700`) and slice 3's shape (PR #23670): the bodies of `RestServer#registerSharingEndpoints` (the per-record share family: `GET` / `POST {basePath}/data/:object/:id/shares` and `DELETE …/shares/:shareId`, 3 routes) and `RestServer#registerSharingRuleEndpoints` (the sharing-rule family under `{basePath}/sharing/rules`: list, create, read, delete, evaluate, 5 routes) move, unedited, to ONE new module, `packages/rest/src/sharing-routes.ts`. It is move-only: routes, the ordered registrations, every handler and the published `dist/*.d.ts` are byte-identical, and every reader whose reading included a moved line now reads it where it is, with its sum unchanged.

`rest-server.ts` goes from 12,119 to 11,495 lines (measured on `origin/main` `c9810dd9d1`, which this branch merged). The card stays open for the later slices.

## The pattern, applied

**Members the moved bodies read**, from an AST walk of each method (base `361a1c46d`; both bodies re-verified byte-identical against `c9810dd9d1`, where they sit at :11066-:11508 and :11524-:11736):

| registrar | fields | methods |
|---|---|---|
| `registerSharingEndpoints` (5 members) | `config` (1 read), `routeManager` (3), `sharingServiceProvider` (2, inside `resolveService`) | `resolveExecCtx` (3), `enforceAuth` (3) |
| `registerSharingRuleEndpoints` (4 members) | `routeManager` (5), `sharingRulesServiceProvider` (2, inside `resolveService`) | `resolveExecCtx` (5), `enforceAuth` (5) |

Neither body has a bare `this` or an element access on `this`. The module-level names they read are all imports (`ErrorCode`, `INTERNAL_ERROR_MESSAGE`, `sendError` as `sendEnvelopeError`, `standardErrorCodeForHttpStatus`, `boundedDeclaredUserMessage`, `classifiedRefusalAnswer`, `nestedRefusalEnvelope`, `sandboxFaultAnswer`, `logError`, `refuseRepeatedQueryParams`). Every one of them is still used elsewhere in `rest-server.ts` (counted by AST outside the moved ranges), so each import stays there and the new module imports the same names from the same modules. **Nothing declared in `rest-server.ts` is read, so no export was added anywhere.**

**Host shape (slice 1's shape B, twice):** the class keeps both private methods with their names, docblocks and positions. Each body is now one host literal (`SharingRouteHost`, `SharingRuleRouteHost`, one interface per registrar so each lists exactly what its body reads) plus `.call(host, basePath)`. Each interface member is typed `RestServer['m']`; methods go as late-bound closures, `(...a) => this.m(...a)`. The call sites in `registerRoutes` are unchanged.

**Fields, checked one by one:**

| field | read when | reassigned after registration? | handed over as |
|---|---|---|---|
| `config` | registration only (`const { crud } = this.config;`, the body's first line) | no (constructor only) | value |
| `routeManager` | registration only (every `register` call) | its one swap wraps `registerMetadataEndpointsInner`, not these registrars | value |
| `sharingServiceProvider` | **request time** (`resolveService`, from each handler) | not by the class, but not `readonly` | **getter** |
| `sharingRulesServiceProvider` | **request time** (same) | not by the class, but not `readonly` | **getter** |

The getters are measured, not argued. A one-off vitest file (copied in, run, deleted) boots a source `RestServer` with no provider, drives the door, assigns the field on the instance AFTER `registerRoutes()`, and drives it again:

- this head: `GET /api/v1/data/:object/:id/shares` answers `501 NOT_IMPLEMENTED`, then `200 {"data":[{"id":"shr_1"}]}`; `GET /api/v1/sharing/rules` answers `501`, then `200 {"data":[{"name":"r1"}]}`.
- by-value ablation (`scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, each getter in turn replaced by `X: this.X,`; anchor 1 → 0, replacement 0 → 1, blob `8fd364065fcf` → mutated): the ablated door answers `501` then `501` (frozen at registration) while the other door still reads `200`, in both runs. Restored by the tool and a trap: blob `8fd364065fcf` equals `HEAD`, `git diff HEAD` empty, the one-off test file deleted. The path is source (relative import), so no `dist` leg applies.

**Mechanism hypotheses from the dispatch, measured:** (a) PR #23674 landed first (`c2635881e0`), so this branch merged `origin/main` `c9810dd9d1` once (a merge commit, no conflict) and the whole-file readers were re-run on the merge, the meta-draft-read-door census among them (8 exact). (b) `enforceAuth` and `resolveExecCtx` are class methods, handed over as closures, not exported helpers; the rule-family field is spelled `sharingRulesServiceProvider`; both provider fields go as getters. (c) The `:111` import comment ("see its use in `registerSharingEndpoints`") now says that body lives in `sharing-routes.ts`.

## The registrar list

`packages/rest/src/rest-server-registrar-files.ts` gains `sharing-routes.ts` with a `[#23050 slice 4]` comment (length 4 → 5). Every reader that pins its length re-reads its number, and every sum is unchanged:

| reader | sum over the list | change |
|---|---|---|
| `rest-server-query-number-census.test.ts` | 9 = 8 + 1 + 0 + 0 + 0 | length 4 → 5 |
| `rest-server-canonical-query-ast.test.ts` | 4 = 1 + 3 + 0 + 0 + 0 `query:` slots | floor `sharing-routes.ts: 0`, length 4 → 5 |
| `meta-draft-read-door-census.test.ts` | 8 = 8 + 0 + 0 + 0 + 0 | length 4 → 5 |
| `rest-server-docblock-position.test.ts` | floors 4 + 3 + 3 + 8 = 18 | floor `sharing-routes.ts: 8` (header, two host interfaces, two functions, and the three blocks that moved with the share body), length 4 → 5 |
| `execctx-consumer-census.test.ts` | 62 sites = 33 + 9 + 5 + 7 + 8 | mentions 89 → 97 (the seam, twice: two forwarders and two interface members); forwarders pinned one per moved REGISTRAR (5 = 4 modules + `EXTRA_MOVED_REGISTRARS`, since this module carries two) |
| `ui-view-route-identity.measurement.test.ts` / `ui-view-route-tenancy.measurement.test.ts` | `this.enforceAuth(` 52, `this.resolveExecCtx(` 67 over the list (50 / 65 before, +1 each per forwarder); ownership guard 1 | length 4 → 5 |
| dogfood `authz-conformance.test.ts` (realtime tripwires) | 0 hits over the five files | length 4 → 5 |
| dogfood `authz-probe-blind-spot.census.ts`, `rest-server.ts` row | 70 / 19 / 51 unchanged; `this.routeManager.register(` 63 = 34 + 9 + 5 + 7 + 8 | new control `sharing-routes.ts: this.routeManager.register(` 8; `registrar list length` 5; `enforceAuth` 72 → 80, re-anchored (the seam, twice; no call site added) |

## Proof of move-only

- **`.d.ts`:** `packages/rest/dist/index.d.ts` and `index.d.cts` built at `origin/main` `c9810dd9d1` (a separate worktree) and at this branch's merge head are byte-identical: sha256 `7489de84bc6feccb7cb1f28bcbe4a97775324959c61c9bfc35e8a8c45a6f3bc9` for all four files, `cmp` silent. The ESM and CJS bundles both load with 39 exports, one sorted export-name list (sha256 `84008c9643d5…`) on both sides. `SharingRouteHost`, `SharingRuleRouteHost` and `sharing-routes` appear nowhere in the `.d.ts`; `src/index.ts` is untouched. The bundle JS bytes differ, because code moved within it.
- **Routes:** a source `RestServer` on a recording mock server, with a protocol that answers every member, dumped under four configs at `c9810dd9d1` and at this head: `getRoutes()` (functions as arity), the ordered server registration calls, and a whitespace-free sha256 of every handler's source. **12 dumps of 12 are byte-identical.** default: routes `ee3a764e19bd…`, calls `0d002057270d…`, handlers `8581c62bc47c…` (75 routes, 8 sharing); scoped-optional: `eb7a21beb5de…` / `c49ba58f5cff…` / `b853abe81f98…` (150, 16); scoped-required: `d6d0e5068384…` / `71d12ded1756…` / `f06c27a6c600…` (75, 8); a fourth config with every provider set equals default. The routes digests match slice 3's for the same configs.
- **The handler digest can fail:** a positive control mutated one character of one moved handler (`List shares error:` → `!`, through `ablation-replace.mjs`) and the dump's handler list differed in exactly `GET /api/v1/data/:object/:id/shares`, with routes and calls unchanged; restored, blob equals `HEAD`.
- **Moved bodies:** `c9810dd9d1`'s `rest-server.ts` lines 11066-11508 and 11524-11736, with one 4-space indent removed, against `sharing-routes.ts` lines 102-544 and 553-765: `diff` exits 0 both times (443 + 213 lines). No moved line holds a multi-line string or template literal (every odd-backtick line is a comment), so re-indenting changes no runtime string.
- **Moved-line accounting:** `git diff --color-moved=plain --color-moved-ws=allow-indentation-change c9810dd9d1 HEAD` over the two files: 655 deleted and 683 added lines detected as moved; `rest-server.ts` is +33 / -657: the two stubs (23 lines; the diff keeps each method's closing lines in place), the 7-line import and the 3-line re-pointed `:111` comment.

## Readers re-pointed (sums unchanged, no gate loosened)

- `scripts/check-route-envelope.mjs` (a gate's target paths): `sharing-routes.ts` is discovered by the `*-routes.ts` convention and declared `dialectOnly` with ratchet #9559, as the three earlier modules are, at its measured `stringError 0`, `siblingCode 4` (the sharing-rule `handleError`'s four `{ code, error }` arms). `rest-server.ts` `siblingCode` 22 → 18; `stringError` stays 17 (no literal-string arm moved). Sums 17 + 13 + 8 + 1 + 0 = 39 and 18 + 15 + 8 + 9 + 4 = 54, unchanged. Output differs from base only in those lines (14 → 15 modules, 5 → 6 ratcheted). `--self-test` green.
- **New ADR anchor** `scripts/adr-anchors/packages__rest__src__sharing-routes.ts.json` (ADR-0111, ADR-0112). `check-adr-anchors` verifies `ADR-NNNN Dk` citations only on the anchored surface; the eight in the moved bodies (`ADR-0111 D1/D4/D5/D6/D7`, `ADR-0112 D4/D5`) were on it only because `rest-server.ts` is anchored, and the move dropped the reading 1756 → 1748 decision-letter citations with the gate still green. Anchoring the module restores 1756, with an invariant that adds no letter citation of its own (66 → 67 anchored files). This is the one reader whose re-point needed a new entry rather than an edit.
- `docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/access-security.json`: the two `rest-server.ts#registerSharingRuleEndpoints` anchors name `sharing-routes.ts#registerSharingRuleEndpoints`, where the routes they describe now live (slice 2's precedent for `batch-routes.ts#registerBatchEndpoints`). Both resolved before and after (the private stub keeps the name), so this one was never red; `check:platform-checklist` output differs only in its cited-sources count (345 → 346).
- Prose pointers that named `rest-server.ts` as the home of `respondSharingError`: `rest-share-declared-code.test.ts` and `rest-share-user-message.test.ts` headers, and two comments in `error-response.ts` (not in the published `.d.ts`; the `.d.ts` above is unchanged).

**Red before the re-points**, each measured with the move in place: at `12e48a7d36` (the move alone) the `rest` suite read `Test Files 6 failed | 279 passed (285)`, `Tests 7 failed | 5850 passed | 326 skipped (6183)` (five list readers' length pins, plus the docblock pin's length pin and its new module, which had no floor yet; `canonical-query-ast` is in the `repo` project). The dogfood pair, with its two files at that commit's text, read `Tests 2 failed | 106 passed (108)` (list length; the census row's `registrar list length` control). `check:route-envelope`: `sharing-routes.ts NOT DECLARED` (both tables) and `rest-server.ts` siblingCode 18 against 22.

## Readers examined and not re-pointed

- `objectql-slot-consumer-census`, `auth-gate-allowlist-fault-window`, `execctx-authz-input-seam-reachability`, runtime `meta-list-projection-parity`, core `authz-store-unavailable`: they read other members of `rest-server.ts` (`objectQLProvider`, the gate block, `computeExecCtx`, `/meta`, `resolveAuthzContext`), none of which the moved bodies touch.
- The ADR anchor `packages__rest__src__rest-server.ts.json` (ADR-0045, `filterAppForUser`) is unaffected.
- No `rest-server.ts:NNNNN` line citation points into the moved range.
- Gate outputs, base `c9810dd9d1` vs this head, identical: `check-durability-degradation-log-level`, `check-system-context-census`, `check-single-authz-resolver`, `check-rest-log-declared`, `check:liveness`, `check:cross-package-test-inputs`, `check:issue-citations`, `check:test-source-alias`, `check:rest-log-spy-declared`. Identical except the scanned-file count (+1, the new module): `check-meta-type-normalized`, `check-dispatcher-error-vocabulary` (57 sites, 57 classified), `check:error-status-conformance` (463 producer sites), `check:doc-authoring`, `check:nul-bytes`, `check-undeclared-dep-imports` (+3 specifiers). `check-scripts-symbol-anchors` +4 file-level anchors (the new comments in `check-route-envelope.mjs`); `check-affected-docs` 22 → 23 route sources (the new module, admitted by the filename convention).

## Acceptance notes

- **`packages/spec` reader, not edited (the claim keeps `packages/spec` out):** `packages/spec/liveness/crud_endpoints.json`'s `dataPrefix` evidence names `rest-server.ts#registerSharingEndpoints` ("each builds its own dataPath the same way"); that `dataPath` line now lives in `sharing-routes.ts`. The anchor still resolves (the private method keeps the name) and `check:liveness` is identical base vs head. It joins the two pointers in the same string that slices 1 and 2 carried to the CRUD slice.
- `packages/spec/src/api/error-code-ledger.zod.ts` (about :219 and :1759) names `respondSharingError` without a file, so it still lands; not edited.
- Prose in other lanes that names `rest-server.ts` for code now in `sharing-routes.ts`, read by nothing: `packages/types/src/data-error-classification.ts` (about :243, :507, :707), `packages/plugins/plugin-sharing/src/sharing-rule-service.ts` (about :503) and three `plugin-sharing` tests (`sharing-rule.test.ts` :1345, `sharing-service.test.ts` :1114, `federated-phantom-owner-scoping.test.ts` :460). Not edited.
- `docs/adr/0111-…md`'s Consumers line names `rest-server.ts` for the sharing / sharing-rule routes; a governed surface, not edited here (as slice 3 left ADR-0076).
- `docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/access-security.json`'s first re-pointed anchor says the record-shares family is "registered inline, under no registrar of its own"; it is registered by `registerSharingEndpoints`. Re-pointed, not re-judged.
- `rest-server-docblock-position.test.ts`'s header still records that the `registerSharingEndpoints` route table was once orphaned; that docblock stays in `rest-server.ts`, so the sentence is still true.
- Lines of `rest-server.ts` from the new import (about :325) to the two registrars shift by +7, and after them by -624 (`c9810dd9d1` :11739 is this head's :11115).

## Gates and tests

Measured at this branch: base `361a1c46d`, one merge of `origin/main` `c9810dd9d1` (`20c00f5280`), then two commits that touch no package source (`aa4ad8f41c` the ADR anchor, `7b101d0a64` a comment in one test). `origin/main` has since moved to `3bc407d307` (objectql and metadata-protocol only, no file in this diff); not merged, PR CI runs the merge ref. All builds and tests went through `os-verify-lock`; every exit code was captured to a file before any pipe.

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/rest exec vitest run --project local` at `20c00f5280`: Test Files 285 passed (285), Tests 5860 passed / 326 skipped (6186). `rest-server-docblock-position.test.ts` re-run at `7b101d0a64`: 11 passed.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/rest exec vitest run --project repo` at `20c00f5280`: Test Files 5 passed (5), Tests 226 passed / 5 skipped (231).
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/rest typecheck` at `20c00f5280`: exit 0 (`tsc --noEmit`, then `check:test-typecheck`: 0 file(s) / 0 error(s)).
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood exec vitest run test/authz-probe-blind-spot.test.ts test/authz-conformance.test.ts` at `20c00f5280`: Test Files 2 passed (2), Tests 108 passed (108).
- Lint (the proven narrowing): `eslint --no-inline-config --format json` over `packages/rest`, the two dogfood files, `scripts/check-route-envelope.mjs` and the checklist JSON: 328 files, 0 errors; the one warning is eslint's "File ignored because no matching configuration was supplied" for the JSON, which shows `eslint .` never lints it. Every one of the 16 other changed files is in the result set at 0 / 0. The published `.d.ts` is byte-identical, so no consumer outside `packages/rest` can lint differently. Repo-wide `pnpm lint` is CI's.
- `dispatch-gates --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack`, no paths, at the final head `7b101d0a64`: 81 commands (80 at `20c00f5280`; the ADR anchor adds `pnpm check:adr-anchors`). All 81 ran at `7b101d0a64` and exited 0. `--ran`: `Run reconciliation — 81 derived, 81 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN.`
- Among them `pnpm check:route-envelope` (its `--self-test`, then the scan), `pnpm check:adr-anchors` (1756 decision-letter citations, 67 anchored files), `pnpm check:platform-checklist`, `pnpm check:durability-log-level`, `pnpm check:dispatcher-error-vocabulary` and `pnpm check:dual-build-cjs-loads` (exit 0: the dogfood closure build left every package it reads built). No test file executes `check-route-envelope.mjs`.
- An earlier union at `20c00f5280` read `pnpm check:dts-closure` exit 1 (runtime and service-automation `.d.ts` missing) because it ran while this branch's own `@objectstack/verify` closure build was rewriting those `dist/` folders; re-run after that build: exit 0, 175/175 declaration files present. The final union above ran with no build beside it.
- `check:dev-prereqs` and `check:skill-frame-freshness` (local-only) were not run: no `packages/spec` build input and no four-axis frame file is touched.
